payload.text: **Estate coordination (hv, 26 Oct, decision 20):** the VCs are up, and hv starts builders only when their project is called. One heavy runs at a time on rhadamanth, and a kovacs leg counts as heavy; lights run beside it. Order: Molt, Devbin, Utilz, Intent, Gtools, Conflab, Laksa. kovacs-sysadm is reached by name over Remote Control. **Since 13:19:49Z the desk runs on Intent's slots, with molt-vc as controller** (hv, relayed verbatim by intent-vc: "yes, have molt-vc take control after the preflight END"; Intent decision 88): READY is `intent estate slots ask` in the asking session, GO is `slots grant <id> --lane <every lane held>`, START and END are `slots start` and `release` (kovacs ones `--relayed`), still mirrored by message until Part B lands.
